notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.2024.710.1320
notes.notes:
Replaced South African flip flop with a new one.
Added two new flip flops (Britannia Basher & Kyiv Kicker)
Added points earned or lost visual effects when hitting bugs.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.2024.710.1319
notes.notes:
A couple of asset changes on certain levels.
Increased the bug spawn interval when food is on the screen. Making hitting bugs and protecting food a bit more challenging.
 Additional bug bash sound effects were added.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.1169.23360
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue of victory music continuing to play after quitting to the menu.
 Fixed the Steam Achievement for winning the game that was not unlocking.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.1164.23354
notes.notes:
Added level 20
 Expanded the list of Steam Achievements

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.1157.23354
notes.notes:
Minor visual improvements
 Added in-game notification for unlocking an achievement

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.1129.23354
notes.notes:
We have added the following features to the game:

 Steam Achievements to reward your progress
 Steam Cloud to sync your level progress across devices
 A new level 19 to challenge your skills

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.1116.23354
notes.notes:
Introduced levels 17 and 18 with fresh bugs and obstacles
 Resolved a bug that caused excess food to appear when the game was paused with food on the screen

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.1105.23353
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made to the game:

 Levels now include gameplay information
 Players can select from 9 different types of flip-flops
 Game no longer crashes when quitting to menu and starting a new game
 Quitting game requires confirmation from the player

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.1051.23353
notes.notes:
Added Fade-In and Fade-Out for Ambient Sounds
 Fixed progress bar, not resetting to 0% when levelling up.
 Added levels 13 - 16, which feature six new bugs and nine new food options.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.982.23352
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made:


 Fixed a bug that caused lower scores to overwrite the highscore
 Added a progress bar to show the level completion status
 Reset the counters for killed and escaped bugs to zero on each level up
 Added a new level (level 12)
 Added a screen to celebrate the game victory
 Fixed a bug that prevented some food items from appearing on certain levels
 Increased the level requirements to make the game more challenging

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.910.23350
notes.notes: Corrected an issue that caused incorrect bugs to appear on levels 8-10.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.908.23348
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made to the game:


 Birds will explode upon touching food. This has no effect on the gameplay.
 The images of the grey bird and the worm have been updated.
 A new level, "Allotment Assault", has been added. It features bees that will chase hungry bugs when food is on the screen and remove their hunger. Killing a bee will reduce your score.
 The name of level 10 has been corrected.
 The score requirements for each level have been lowered to make it easier to advance to the next one.
 The menu buttons will no longer shrink after returning to the menu on low-resolution screens.
 The food detection area has been decreased so that bugs have to get closer to food before they can eat it.
 The game will not crash anymore if there are no speakers or soundcard available.
 The flickering around bugs on low-resolution screens has been fixed.
 The bug collision behaviour has been improved to prevent bugs from getting stuck.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.758.23337
notes.notes: Fixed: The current level is not correctly saved when quitting the game, causing clicking on "Play Now" will start from level 1.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.757.23336
notes.notes:
Fixed incorrect level loaded when clicking on the "Play Now" button.
 Fixed level name not showing when levelling up.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.741.23336
notes.notes:
Added "New Game" button which will start the game from level 1.
 The "Play Now" button will start the game on the last level the player was on. The score will be set to the minimum required score to reach that specific level.
 Pressing escape during gameplay will now quit to the menu. Press escape again to quit the game.
 Lowered the speed of specific bugs that were too fast.
 Added three new levels.
 Added level names.
 Level 1 now has a background and ambient sound instead of a screen capture of the user's desktop.
 Fixed some flickering around bugs on certain levels.
 Added more food types.
 The time to protect food will now be random. Either 1, 2 or 3 minutes.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.632.23336
notes.notes:
UI improvements.
 Fixed: Birds going off-screen were incorrectly counted as an escaped bug.
 Fixed: Added a missing sound file.
 Birds will no longer spawn from the screen's bottom edge to prevent them from accidentally getting stuck near the banner.
 Lowered the speed of one of the spiders to make it a little easier to progress in level 2.
 Fixed: Birds did not spawn after failing on a level while a bird was on the screen, and the player started a new game.
 Slightly increased the hit zone of a bug to fix an issue where bugs were not hit even when they should have been hit.
 Slightly increased the time a bug takes to smell food before moving towards it.
 Increased the change in direction when a bug collides with the banner or other bugs.
 Added a highscore.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.573.23335
notes.notes:
Performance improvements
 UI updates

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.487.23335
notes.notes: Fixed: Ambient music does not stop when restarting the game.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.486.23335
notes.notes:
Added more sound effects
 Changed game dynamics. Bugs now have different levels of hunger. The hungrier they are, the faster they'll move towards the food. Spiders can also get hungry, but sometimes a bug might not be hungry and therefore not be interested in eating the food. Birds will still only eat bugs and not food.
 Made it slightly easier to progress to level 2.
 Added two new birds.
 Specific bugs are now only available on certain levels.
 Updated game logo.
 Update "Game Over" screen.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.429.23334
notes.notes:
Added more bugs to bash
 Added more fruit to protect
 Different levels now have different types of fruit to protect
 Added ambient sounds to levels
 Replaced level backgrounds with new ones

notes.title: Second Update Notes for 30 November 2023
notes.notes:
Improved bug collision behaviour
 Fixed an issue with a bird not eating all the bugs
 Added three new bugs (a fly and two different worms)
 Added two new fruits (raspberry and blueberry)

notes.title: Update Notes for 30 November 2023
notes.notes:
Minor performance improvements.
 Fixed some issues when bugs collided with the banner and got stuck while the fruit was displayed on the screen.
 Added collision detection with other bugs.
 Added "Game Over" when the player score drops below -100.
 Added a short delay for bugs moving towards fruit when entering the screen.
